content: Kyeego Taatabhugya akuzomererwa
Mugeenderere okwiiseega emwe kwe emwe kya abhahiiri.
Muteebha okubhaginihya abhagini muziinyuumba zyeenyu, kwo okubha munzira yiyo, abhaatu abhaandi bhabhaginihirye bhamaraika bha Taatabhugya bhutamenya.
Mubhahiite bhano bhabhohirwe mukibhoho. Mubhe kyamuna mubhohirwe hamwe nabho. Mubhahiite bhano bhakunyaakibhwa, mubhe kyamuna neemwe mukunyaakibhwa.
Obhukweeri bhureenderwa bhusuukwe na abhaatu bhoosi. Omusubhe no omukari bhiiriihe no obhuseebheeti, kwo okubha Taatabhugya arabhatinira ekiina abhaseebheeti na abhatuungiri.
Mutabha ne eteemwa yo okuseega eziimbirya, nawe mwiiswe na bhino munabhyo, kwo okubha Taatabhugya omweene akabhuga, “Nitakukutiga naabhe nitakukweebha na rumwe.”
Nikyo ekigirirye turanagya okugaamba kwo obhwiisige,
Mubhahiite abhakaangati bheenyu bhano bhaari bhakubheegya engʼana ya Taatabhugya. Mwiiseege iguru we eteemo yaabhu kyeego bhaari bhakwiikara, na mutuniirire obhwiikirirya bhwaabhu.
Yeesu Krisito atakwiikyoora. Ewe ni wuryawurya, izo, reero na kirakeego.

Mutakaangiribhwa na ameegyo agaandi amagini, kwo okubha orubhaango rwa Taatabhugya nirwo rukugumirya eziikoro zeenyu, naabhe gitari emigiro iguru ye ebhyaakurya. Emigiro giyo, gitakubhasakirya kyokyoosi bhano bhakugituniirira.
Etwe tuna Yeesu kyeego ekimweeso kyeetu. Abhaatu bhano bhakugeenderera kuruusya ekimweeso mwiibhuru rya Abhayahudi bhatakwiikiriribhwa kubhona obhweera bhwe ekimweeso kya Yeesu.

Kuriingʼaana ne emigiro gya Musa, omuseengeri omukuru ahaagega amanyiinga ge emitugo no okugya nago Ahahoreeru ha Ahahoreeru, okubha aruusye ekimweeso kwiiguru ye ebhibhi. Nawe eziinyama zye emitugo giyo zihaagegwa no okwookibhwa igutu wo omugye.
Nikyo ekigirirye Yeesu neewe akanyaakibhwa no okwiitwa igutu yo omugye gwa Yerusaremu, okubha abheerye abhaatu ebhibhi bhyaabhu kwe enzira ya amanyiinga gaaye.
Kweego na neetwe tumutuniirire igutu yo omugye, no okubhona eziisoni zino ewe yabhweeni.
Tukore ego kwo okubha mukyaaro kino tutana mugye guno gukugumira kirakeego, nawe turaganyirira kusikira mumugye gwa mwiisaaro guno gukuuza.
Ambe, tugeenderere okumukumya Taatabhugya kuhitira ku Yeesu kirakeego. Kwo okubha amangʼana geetu go okukumya eriina ryaaye, ni kye ekimweeso kino tukumuruusirya.
Mugeenderere okubhasakirya abharikyeenyu no okugwaatana nabho kubhigiro bhino munabhyo, kwo okukora ego, nikyo ekimweeso kino kikumuzomera Taatabhugya.

Mubhiigwe abhakaangati bheenyu no okutuniirira gano bhakubhaswaagya, kwo okubha ebho nibho bhakuteengeeza na bhareenderwa okukeerenerya emirimo gyaabhu embere wa Taatabhugya. Kweego mubhiigwe, okubha bhakore emirimo gyaabhu kwo obhuzomererwa. Nawe eraabhe mutakubhiigwa, bharakora emirimo kwe ebhigoongi, ne emirimo gyaabhu gitakubha na bhweera bhwobhwoosi kweemwe.
Mugeenderere kutusabhira. Tuno obhuheene kubha, emitima gyeetu ni mizomu, kwo okubha tureenda okukora ge eheene kubhaatu bhoosi.
Ndabhiisasaama bhukongʼu, mubhe muranisabhira ku Taatabhugya, okubha ninagye kukyoora kweemwe bhwaangu.
Amangʼana go obhuteero

Taatabhugya omweene wuno akutuha omureembe akamuryoora Omukuru weetu Yeesu. Ewe niwe Omuriisya Omukuru we eziingʼoondu, kwe enzira yo okwiitira amanyiinga gaaye gano gakweerekya eriiragano rya kirakeego.
Taatabhugya abhahe amazomu goosi, okubha mukore obhuseegi bhwaaye. Kweeki akore muziikoro zyeetu gano gakumuzomera kwe enzira ya Yeesu Krisito. Ewe aguungibhwe kirakeego na kirakeego. Gabhe ego.
Ndabhiisasaama abhahiiri bhaane, mubhe muratuniirira amangʼana gayo go okubhatoongera ekoro, kwo okubha nibhakaamiiri enyaarubha nguhi ego.
Ndeenda mumenye kubha, omwiikirirya omurikyeetu Timoteo, yiiguriirwe okurwa munyuumba ya abhabhohwa. Eraabhe araanguha kuuza, niraaza neewe oweenyu okubhataarira.
Mubhakeerye abhakaangati bheenyu bhoosi, na abhahoreeru bhoosi bhano bhari eyo. Abhahoreeru okurwa mukyaaro kya Itaria, bharabhakeerya.
Orubhaango rwa Taatabhugya rubhe hamwe neemwe mwoosi.
